t: Publication Of An Anti-Japanee Article In China Evening News Of June 3

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date: June 5, 1936.

（印：File MUNICIPAL POLICE O. REGISTRY Dated 5/6/36）

Subject (in full) Publication of an anti-Japanese article in
China Evening News of June 3.

Made by... D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by... （签名）

In connection with the publication of an article in
the China Evening News of June 3, 1936, alleging that the
Municipal Police had prohibited the performance of a play in
the New World Amusement Resort, 2-6 Bubbling Well Road,
enquiries were made at the office of the paper, Avenue Edward
VII, and one named Huang Zou-zuan (汪淵然), one of the
editors, who was responsible for the article, was interviewed.
According to this person, the article in question was copied
from the New World, a Soviet paper, dated May 29, 1936.
The extract from the "New World" is attached herewith.

Sih Tse liang
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：Copied from
Japanese press apparently
JR）

事由（全称） 6月3日《China Evening News》刊登反日文章一事。

呈报人…… 侦探长 Sih Tse-liang 转呈人…… （签名）

就1936年6月3日《China Evening News》刊登一篇文章，声称工部局警务处禁止在南京路2-6号“新世界”游乐场演出话剧一事，经向该报社（位于爱多亚路）查询，并约谈了负责该文章的编辑之一黄祖uan（汪淵然）(音译)。据此人称，有关文章系抄自1936年5月29日出版的苏联报纸《New World》。现附上摘自《New World》的译文。

Sih Tse liang
侦探长

Extract from the "New World", a Russian Paper, of 29/5/36
-----------------

X Anti-Japanese Play X
Banned
A play, depicting the current developments in North China from anti-Japanese angle, which has been stealing crowds from the other attractions at the New World amusement center, Nanking and Thibet Roads, has been banned by the municipal authorities.

《Hsin Evening News》：

          华人与反帝运动

          不久前，工部局警务处派遣警员前往位于南京路与西藏路交界处的上海世界游乐场（上海世界），制止一出话剧的演出，因为该剧鼓吹抵抗 X。
          华人在任何外国均不被允许开展反帝运动；在中国境内也不被允许这样做。
          中国人民已无立锥之地。

（正文）：
In accordance with instructions from Officer i/c
Special Branch, a visit was paid by the undersigned to the
"New World," 2- 6 Bubbling Well Road, at 6.45
p.m. May 29. In the absence of the manager named Yang Hung-
chih (楊鴻志), the accountant, Tsaung Chao-sai (章紹三)
and the person i/c of stage plays named Nyi Chong-kwei
(倪昌貴) were interviewed and asked whether they had
recently received any warnings from the S.I.P. or S.I.C.
regarding anti-Japanese performances. In reply they stated
that with the exception of the occasional routine visits by
Police, no representations or warnings had ever been received
from the Municipal Authorities. On being told of the report
" in the Japanese newspapers alleging the receipt of a warning
by the management of the New World against anti-Japanese shows,
they declared that they had no knowledge of such warning, but
remarked that in the evenings of May 25, 26 and 27 two persons,
one dressed in a light grey foreign suit and believed to be
a Japanese, and a Chinese dressed in a grey long gown, were
seen among the patrons of the resort. According to the staff
of the New World, these two men were very inquisitive and paid
close attention to each act in progress on various stages. At
about 11 p.m. May 28, 1936, a telephone message was received by
the Office asking whether there was any anti-Japanese propaganda
or anything relating to the Sino-Japanese dispute, exhibited
in the modern dramatic play entitled "It is I." (就是我),
now on show daily. The caller represented himself as a news-
paperman but did not give the name of the paper. He was given
to understand that the play was an old one, written about
twenty years ago, and that it was a detective and romantic

（正文）：
遵照特别股主管警官的指示，具名者于5月29日下午6时45分前往南京路2-6号“新世界”进行查访。因经理杨鸿志（楊鴻志）不在，会见了会计师章绍三（章紹三）及负责舞台剧演出的倪昌贵（倪昌貴），询问他们近期是否收到过工部局警务处或工部局警务处关于反日演出的任何警告。他们回答说，除了警方偶尔的例行巡视外，从未收到过市政当局的任何交涉或警告。当告知他们日文报刊中有报道声称“新世界”管理层曾收到关于反日演出的警告时，他们表示对此类警告毫不知情，但指出在5月25日、26日和27日晚，游乐场的顾客中曾出现两人，一人身穿浅灰色西式服装，被认为是日本人，另一人身穿灰色长衫的华人。据“新世界”职员称，这两人非常好打听，密切注意各个舞台上正在进行的每一幕演出。1936年5月28日晚11时许，办公室接到一个电话，询问目前正在每日上演的现代话剧《就是我》中，是否有任何反日宣传或与中日争端相关的内容。来电者自称是新闻记者，但未透露报社名称。对方获悉该剧是一出旧剧，创作于约二十年前，是一部侦探言情

Extract from Afternoon Translation of May 28, 1936

NICHI-NICHI

S.M.C. PROHIBITS ANTI-JAPANESE DRAMATIC PERFORMANCE

It is reported that the S.M.C. has warned the
manager of the New World Theatre not to stage any anti-
Japanese play in future because it has been ascertained
that the theatre had lately given anti-Japanese
performances.
pages.zh:
摘自1936年5月28日下午译稿

《NICHI-NICHI》

工部局禁止反日戏剧演出

据报道，工部局已警告“新世界”剧院经理，今后不得上演任何反日话剧，因为经查实，该剧院最近曾进行反日演出。
